criteria.criterion: T4 seed stability (std of MILD Det/DA over seeds, at equal FP)
criteria.value: 4.13 pp at equal FP; 8.12 pp with validation-tuned thresholds (5 seeds)
criteria.why: The equal-FP spread measures how stable the learned risk ranking is. The spread with validation-tuned thresholds also contains threshold calibration noise, which T6 covers.

criteria.criterion: T5 generalisation (dev validation vs held-out test, MILD)
criteria.why: A large drop means the tuning over-fitted the development period or the test period differs.

criteria.criterion: T6 false alarms of MILD on the test set
criteria.rule: PASS <= 2 x budget, WARN <= 4 x budget
criteria.why: The FP budget is tuned on development data. Much higher test FP means poor calibration.

criteria.criterion: T7 no blind intent (MILD per-intent detection, min)
criteria.why: An intent that is almost never detected makes the macro averages misleading.
Beating a collapsed baseline proves nothing. Check its job.log.
